title: Model families and stated memberships in the knowledge base (M)
description:
Follow-up from the 2026-10-22 Shipped knowledge refresh, which accepted only one `member_of` relation (Qwen3.8-27B → Qwen3.8). Linked Shipped story: ship-87b02c (periodic table), where model families and "built on" feed the isotopes and the family grouping. Spans Papyrus and Biblicus.

## Scope
1. **Family entities for stated series.** Create `model_family` entities for series the sources name, for example Qwen3.8, MiMo-V2.6 and MiniCPM5. Re-kind Qwen3.8 from `model` to `model_family`, which fixes the current model-to-model "Member of" pair. Re-kinding must keep the entity's slug and wiki URL, or redirect them.
2. **Extractor recall for stated memberships** (Biblicus GLiNER2 plus the alias registry and AI review). Test cases from the misses: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL → MiMo-V2.6, and MiniCPM5-2B → MiniCPM5. Keep the stated-evidence-only rule: no membership without text that states it, and leave a model unrelated when unsure.
3. **Reverse label.** A family page lists its members under "Members". A model page keeps "Member of <family>".

## Acceptance
- The next weekly run shows on the wiki at least the Qwen3.8, MiMo-V2.6 and MiniCPM5 families, each with its stated members, and no unstated memberships.
- Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) and unit tests: re-kind without URL loss, the two recall cases, the stated-evidence-only rule (a negative case), and both label directions.
- It lands in the weekly cloud run, with no one-off refresh.

Priority: after PPY-dca7cd (the cloud run) and its packaging fixes.
